$comment: Settings for tools/build_solution.py. Bump 'version' for every release you import: Power Platform only upgrades a solution to a higher version.
description: Power Automate flows that enforce SharePoint Online governance controls (PID v3.1) in BAU.

GovernanceSiteUrl.description: Full URL of the SharePoint site holding the governance lists, e.g. https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/SPOGovernance.

TenantRootUrl.description: Root SharePoint URL, e.g. https://contoso.sharepoint.com. New sites are created under /sites/.

SharePointServiceOwnerEmail.description: Mailbox of the SharePoint service owner (a shared mailbox or distribution list is best). Approves new sites and file share migrations.

InfoSecApproverEmail.description: Security & Architecture approver for guest access, privileged roles and sensitive sites.

ITOpsOwnerEmail.description: IT Operations owner: PIM assignments, file share dispositions, orphaned-site alerts.

ServiceDeskEmail.description: Service Desk shared mailbox that receives fulfilment tickets (AD group changes, access removals).

AutomationSubscriptionId.description: Azure subscription ID of the Automation account that runs Set-SiteGovernanceBaseline.

AutomationResourceGroup.description: Resource group of the Automation account.

AutomationAccountName.description: Name of the Azure Automation account.

ReviewIntervalDays.description: Days between access recertifications for each site.
